messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error when running model in R
parts:
Check to see if your environmental data are loading correctly. It seems they might be downloading into a temporary folder, and if you closed/restarted R or something, it might have lost the connection. So go back a few steps and make sure that is running correctly, or run it again to re-establish the connection.

Bethany
The Wallace Team
